candidates.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
candidates.summary: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.

candidates.title: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
candidates.summary: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

candidates.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
candidates.summary: Enterprise leaders want AI agents to take on more work but don't fully trust them to act correctly every time. Trust in Depth is AWS's layered approach-scope, know, bound, observe, and prove-that lets agents act on their own when their actions can be verified, reserving human judgment for the decisions that need it.

candidates.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
candidates.summary: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.

candidates.title: Build self-improving document processing using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Learn how to build an agentic intelligent document processing (IDP) system using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that classifies, extracts, validates, and learns from business documents with minimal human intervention, automatically handling new document formats without manual template configuration.

candidates.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
candidates.summary: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.
